note: severity: P0 data-loss/security/false-claim, P1 broken core flow, P2 misleading/quality, P3 cosmetic. status: OPEN|IN_PROGRESS|FIXED|WONTFIX|DISCLOSED. OPP-* are scout opportunities (impact x feasibility / complexity); K-* are defects.
